name: Inashiki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Inashiki city emblem in green and light blue: a green disc with a light blue upper edge and white stylised birds.
history: Municipal flag of Inashiki, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 2005.
